pre_task_rules_gate.description: V12.36 HARD BLOCKER: Verifies RULES_CATALOG.md is UTF-8 readable and scans src/ for P0 violations. Exit 0=PASS, Exit 1=P0 VIOLATION (work stops), Exit 2=CATALOG UNREADABLE (work stops). Runs FIRST before all other hooks.

exit_codes.1: GATE BLOCKED — P0 violation in src/, work stops, report to Director
exit_codes.2: GATE BLOCKED — RULES_CATALOG.md unreadable, fix encoding first

utf8_repair.description: V12.35 AUTO-REPAIR: Scans all .md/.yaml/.json/.cs/.ps1 files for UTF-16 BOM or UTF-8 BOM encoding and silently converts to UTF-8 no-BOM. Prevents the 'wide-character encoded (UTF-16)' agent warning permanently. Non-blocking — always exits 0.

exit_codes.0: PASS — all files UTF-8 clean (may have auto-repaired some)

ptt_phase_gate.description: V12.36 PTT GATE: Reads PTT_EPIC_ID + PTT_PHASE env vars. If set, verifies via ptt_lamport.py that all prerequisite phases are complete before this phase runs. Also logs phase_start to Lamport event log. Non-PTT tasks: skips silently (exit 0). PTT gate fail: exit 1 (blocking).

env_vars.PTT_PHASE: Phase slug: architect | plan_review | tickets | ticket_review | engineer_T1 | verifier_T1 | engineer_T2 | verifier_T2 | engineer_T3 | verifier_T3 | final_review

exit_codes.0: GATE OPEN — prerequisites satisfied, phase_start logged, proceed
exit_codes.1: GATE CLOSED — prerequisite not complete, work stops

ptt_phase_complete.description: V12.36 PTT COMPLETE: Reads PTT_EPIC_ID + PTT_PHASE + PTT_RESULT env vars. Records phase_complete or phase_fail to Lamport event log and syncs manifest.json lamport_events array. Non-PTT tasks: skips silently. Called by orchestrator after each start_subtask returns.

env_vars.PTT_RESULT: Result token: PLAN_COMPLETE | REVIEW_PASS | REVIEW_FAIL | TICKETS_COMPLETE | TICKET_REVIEW_PASS | TICKET_REVIEW_FAIL | BUILD_PASS | BUILD_FAIL | VERIFY_PASS | VERIFY_FAIL | FINAL_PASS | FINAL_FAIL

exit_codes.0: Recorded COMPLETE (or not a PTT task)

before_new_task.description: Auto-create GitButler virtual branch for new tasks

after_task_complete.description: Auto-commit to GitButler virtual branch with V12 message format

after_edit.description: Auto-assign edited files to current virtual branch (experimental)

after_subagent_batch.description: V2.8: Deterministic MCP compliance audit after every wave-7 batch. Reads WAVE7_BATCH_PHASE + WAVE7_BATCH_EPICS env vars. Exit 0=all pass, Exit 1=failures (redo list at /tmp/wave7_redo.txt), Exit 2=hook error.

env_vars.WAVE7_BATCH_EPICS: Space-separated EPIC-W7-NNN IDs in the completed batch

output_files./tmp/wave7_redo.txt: Failed epic IDs, one per line — read by orchestrator redo loop
output_files./tmp/wave7_audit_result.json: Full JSON audit result for this batch

exit_codes.0: ALL_PASS — orchestrator may proceed to next batch
exit_codes.1: HAS_FAILURES — orchestrator reads /tmp/wave7_redo.txt and re-spawns those epics
exit_codes.2: HOOK_ERROR — missing args or script not found; escalate to Director
